decision_policy.gate_review: A gate may move to completed only when a gate review exists with evidence, decision, and next requirements.
decision_policy.step_review: Each experiment inside a gate must produce a harness manifest, score report when available, ledger entry, and a short decision about whether to iterate inside the gate or advance.

entry_criteria: Repository has a repeatable experiment harness and ledger.
Official scoring output can be parsed into evaluation.score.total.
evidence: learned-20260422T030153Z-aic-lewm-policy-l4-fast scored 3.0 as a submission-eligible learned-policy eval.
real-20260421T231915Z-aic-lewm-3trial-cpu-nogpu collected a 3-trial HDF5 dataset and trained LEWM, but its 257.2016 collection score is not submission-eligible.
exit_criteria: At least one autonomous learned-policy evaluation establishes the current legal baseline.
Ground-truth collection scores are explicitly marked not submission-eligible.
gates.name: Harness and Legal Baseline
gates.objective: Separate legal learned-policy evidence from ground-truth data-collection evidence.

entry_criteria: A successful HDF5 demonstration dataset is available.
Policy runtime can select a non-LEWM planner without changing the lifecycle contract.
evidence: Attempt 1 raw replay completed official eval but scored only Tier 1 on all trials (3.0 total).
Attempt 2 observation-time replay with short Docker router aliases and 2.5 simulated-second horizon completed official eval at 106.576452 total.
Exact task-to-episode matching is correct; remaining failure is final alignment/insertion, not lifecycle or router discovery.
Replay earns proximity credit but no insertion/contact credit, so Gate 2 must add legal closed-loop perception/servo correction.
exit_criteria: Replay planner runs under the official lifecycle interface without eval-time TF or Gazebo state.
Official three-trial eval beats the 3.0 legal learned-policy baseline.
Gate review identifies whether failures are action-replay drift, perception/alignment drift, contact failure, or lifecycle/runtime failure.
gates.name: Replay Baseline
gates.objective: Establish the simplest submission-eligible control baseline from recorded demonstration actions and public task metadata.

entry_criteria: Replay baseline has an official scored failure analysis.
Training labels for port pose, plug pose, insertion axis, and alignment error can be generated from training-time TF.
evidence: Gate 1 completed with 106.576452 replay baseline and no insertion/contact credit.
Gate 2 horizon ablation gate2-20260422T135752Z-replay6p5 scored 122.390015 but still earned no insertion/contact credit.
Replay cadence mismatch was fixed: RecordingCheatCode records at 10Hz, and replay/cloud defaults now use 10Hz with regression tests.
10Hz full-horizon run gate2-20260422T152543Z-replay10hz7p2 improved SFP proximity but scored 96.589071 overall after an SC enclosure collision penalty.
SC stop candidate gate2-20260422T172605Z-scstop2p75 removed the contact penalty and promoted the baseline to 127.780187, but no insertion was detected.
Next iteration must add legal final-centimeter servo/insertion behavior rather than more open-loop replay tuning.
Guarded SFP final-servo run gate2-20260422T191446Z-sfpservoz2 scored 127.294174 and was rejected; fixed downward servo did not earn insertion and trial 2 was already force-loaded at 20.77N.

Delta force-guard run gate2-20260422T212109Z-deltaguard fixed the static-load guard contract and scored 128.017218, but was not promoted because the gain over 127.780187 was below +1.0 and no insertion/contact credit was earned.
Lat-bias candidate gate2-20260422T230909Z-latbias completed at 128.008724 but was rejected: fixed -x/+y/-z final servo tripped trial-1 delta force guard and did not improve insertion/contact credit.
exit_criteria: Perception model predicts target alignment accurately enough for closed-loop convergence in offline validation.
Official eval earns Tier 3 proximity or insertion credit on at least one trial.
Gate review states whether more synthetic rollouts are needed before behavior cloning.
gates.name: Perception Servo
gates.objective: Replace brittle replay drift with legal visual alignment and force-aware insertion control.

entry_criteria: Perception-servo controller exposes residual failure cases.
Synthetic rollout generation can produce many labeled legal-observation trajectories.
exit_criteria: BC or ACT-style policy improves over deterministic replay/servo in official or faithful local eval.
Policy remains wrapped by safety/contact logic and lifecycle deadlines.
Gate review states whether learned actions are stable enough for LEWM primitive ranking.
gates.name: Synthetic BC
gates.objective: Use many training-time ground-truth rollouts to learn a broad legal-observation action prior.

entry_criteria: Controller exposes a compact set of meaningful correction primitives.
LEWM has data containing successful and failed primitive outcomes.
exit_criteria: LEWM critic ranks successful primitive corrections above failed ones offline.
Online LEWM ranking improves or preserves official score without violating runtime deadlines.
Gate review states whether LEWM should become core planner or remain auxiliary.
gates.name: LEWM Critic
gates.objective: Use LEWM as a judge over meaningful correction primitives instead of raw velocity MPC.

entry_criteria: LEWM critic improves primitive selection and meets latency constraints.
Perception/control stack can recover from replay and servo failures.
exit_criteria: LEWM-centered planner beats the best non-LEWM submission candidate under the promotion gate.
Failure analysis shows LEWM is making causal planning improvements, not only acting as a cosmetic scorer.
Submission artifact passes lifecycle, scoring, and no-leakage checks.
gates.name: LEWM Core Planner
gates.objective: Promote LEWM from auxiliary critic to the central planner only if the evidence supports it.

objective: Build a submission-eligible AIC qualification policy that climbs from replay, to legal perception/control, to LEWM-assisted and possibly LEWM-core planning.
